One day, a little girl named Lucy was playing in her room. She looked around her room and saw a big blackboard. She wanted to write on the blackboard, so she wrote a funny story. 
Suddenly, Lucy heard a loud noise. It was her mom calling from the bathroom. "Lucy! Come here!" 
Lucy rushed to the bathroom and saw her mom standing there with a big smile. "I have something for you," her mom said. Lucy was so excited that she immediately hugged her mom.
Her mom took her to the kitchen and pulled out a big box with lots of markers and markers. Lucy couldn't believe her eyes. She quickly grabbed the markers and ran back to her room. 
Her mom smiled and said, "Let's make something special together!" Lucy and her mom spent the whole afternoon drawing and writing on the blackboard. When it was time for bed, Lucy said goodnight to her mom and went to sleep, dreaming of all the fun she would have tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom loved to stretch and feel the warm sun on his fur. He lived in a small house with his friend, a little boy named Tim.
One day, while Tom was stretching in the morning light, he saw a big, round ball. He wanted to play with it, but it was stuck in a tree. Tom was too lazy to climb the tree, so he just stretched his legs to reach the ball. Tim saw Tom and wanted to help him.
Tim found a long stick and used it to get the ball out of the tree. Tom was so happy to have the ball to play with. He stretched his legs again and played with the ball all day long. From that day on, Tom and Tim played with the ball every day, and they were always together. Tom was not lazy anymore, and he loved to stretch and play with his best friend, Tim.

Once upon a time, there was a lazy cat named Tom. Tom loved to sleep all day. He would stretch his legs and get up from his bed. One day, Tom woke up and saw it was time to start his day.
Tom went outside and saw a long line of ants. The ants were walking in a straight line, and Tom thought it was fun. He watched the ants work together to find food. Tom wanted to join the ants, but he was too lazy to walk in their line.
Then, a little bird came and told Tom that he could help. The bird told Tom to stretch his legs and make the line longer. Tom did what the bird said, and the ants used their wings to stretch their legs. Now, Tom could join the ants in their line, and he was not lazy anymore.

example.name: Tim
example.chosen:
Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a youth named Tim. Tim loved to play outside and be eager to try new things. Every day, he would see his friends playing and having fun, but he also liked to explore the world around him.
One day, Tim found a big tree with many fruits on it. He wanted to reach them, but he was too small. He tried and tried, but he could not reach the fruits. Tim felt sad because he really wanted to try new things.
Then, Tim had an idea. He asked his friends to help him. Together, they were able to reach all the fruits on the tree. They were so happy and eager to try them. Tim learned that sometimes, we need help from others to solve our problems. And that was the moral of the story: it is okay to ask our friends and try new things.
